test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution’.

The movie Jumanji __is base on__ a children’s book of the same title.
solution:
The correct answer is:* is based upon.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The underlined segment **'is base on'** is incorrect grammatically.
 
• The correct form to show that something (like a movie, in this context) has its foundation, idea, or basis in something else is '**is based upon**'.
 
• The *auxiliary verb* '**is**' should be followed by the *past participle* '**based**' to form the passive voice correctly.
 
• Also, the correct preposition to use after '**based**' is '**upon**' in this context, meaning that the movie has its origin or foundation in the children's book.

Therefore, the correct substitution is '**is based upon**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** The meaning of ***base ***is ***a conceptual structure or entity on which something draws or depends.***
